title: Training Notes — Covered Parking in the Independent Living Closing Amount
content:
The final month's rented covered parking spaces add to the closing amount of an Independent Living Residency Agreement at the monthly covered parking rent per space, the number of spaces being the quantity on the latest covered parking charge.

**Q. What is the rent per space?**
A. 55.00 per calendar month, the same for the Studio, One-Bedroom, One-Bedroom Deluxe, Two-Bedroom, Two-Bedroom Deluxe and Cottage Home.

**Q. Which charge gives the number of spaces?**
A. The latest covered parking charge on the residency ledger, by service date.

**Q. What is added?**
A. Two or more spaces add 55.00 once for each space to the closing amount; one space adds 55.00 once; no covered parking charge adds no parking amount to the closing amount.

**Q. Is the parking rent prorated for a partly used final month?**
A. No; each space adds a whole month's rent.

**Q. Hypothetical figures?**
A. A latest covered parking charge with a quantity of 2 adds 110.00; with a quantity of 1, 55.00.
